first.error: Perry can't see the screen yet: macOS has to allow “Electron”, the app the desktop pet runs in. Turn it on in System Settings → Privacy & Security → Screen & System Audio Recording (Screen Recording before macOS 15); if it is on already (a Perry update brought a new Electron), remove it with −, then look again and allow it. Then restart the pet: Restart, in his tray icon's menu (not macOS's Quit & Reopen, which would open Electron without him).
